sensor-dial.html.before:
HWiNFO setup steps
  1. Install and start HWiNFO (hwinfo.com) in Sensors-only mode.
  2. In HWiNFO Settings, enable Shared Memory Support. On the free version you can instead click Configure Sensors in the sensor window, open the HWiNFO Gadget tab, tick Enable reporting to Gadget, then tick "Report value in Gadget" on the readings you want (no 12-hour limit).
  3. Pick a reading under Reading.
sensor-dial.html.after:
Sensor setup
  1. Pick a reading under Reading.
  2. If no readings appear, choose Check again or Copy support report under Advanced, Support.
  3. If Tahoma is missing, install Tahoma Bold in Font Book and choose Check again.

sensor-dial.html.before: Warn, Critical and the bar ends apply only to readings in the unit that was on the dial when you last changed any of them, so a temperature limit never fires on a fan. The dial stays themed; the bar, or an overview row's value, takes the alert color. Alerts check the current value in the reading's own unit (°F when °F is on); for bytes and rates that is HWiNFO's number and unit, which the dial may show rescaled.
sensor-dial.html.after: Warn, Critical and the bar ends apply only to readings in the unit that was on the dial when you last changed any of them, so a temperature limit never fires on a fan.
